usage: 今日 (gam1 jat6) is used to refer to the current day, from midnight to midnight.
It can be used alone as a subject, object, or adverbial time phrase in a sentence.
When talking about plans or events, 今日 often helps specify timing clearly without needing extra words.
It can combine with verbs like '去' (heoi3 - to go) or '做' (zou6 - to do) to indicate actions happening today.
今日 contrasts with words like 聽日 (ting1 jat6 - tomorrow) and 昨日 (zok6 jat6 - yesterday) to position events on the timeline.
